title: Google quickly bows to Trump order and renames Lake Ontario ‘Lake America’
excerpt: Google Maps will still show Lake Ontario to Canadian users, a statement said.
content_html:

Google Maps has changed the name of Lake Ontario ⁠to “Lake America” for US users following an executive order from US President Donald Trump.
